description: A man with grey powdered wig and dark brown 18th-century coat with a white cravat leans over a seated shirtless man, his right hand resting on the patient's bare upper back and his head bent low. The patient's white shirt is pulled down around his waist and he looks down. Behind them is a dark wood-panelled room with a desk on the right holding books and papers. Warm candlelight-style lighting falls on the skin. No visible text, frame or border.
